title: A Word to Say to the Woman

story.text: The light is Moor House. Hannah, the old servant, takes Jane for a {BEGGAR} and {SHUTS} the door. Jane sinks on the {DOORSTEP} in the wet and {COLD}. Then a young {CLERGYMAN}, St. John Rivers, comes home: “Hush, Hannah; I have a word to say to the woman.” He and his {SISTERS}, Diana and Mary, take her in and {NURSE} her. She gives a false {NAME}.
story.caption: “Hush, Hannah; I have a word to say to the woman”
